note.rawiso.fig.title: Title of the isotope figure of `raw isotopes`; {mz} = the monoisotopic m/z asked, {a} and {b} = the window, in minutes.
note.rawiso.fig.formula: Second line of the figure: the formula and the adduct compared with, and the m/z of that ion ({formula}, {adduct}, {mz}).
note.rawiso.fig.trace.m: Label of the trace of the first bin; {mz} = the whole mass of the bin.
note.rawiso.fig.trace.m1: Label of the trace of the second bin; {mz} = the whole mass of the bin.
note.rawiso.fig.trace.m2: Label of the trace of the third bin; {mz} = the whole mass of the bin.
note.rawiso.fig.peak: Under a trace label: its highest intensity in the window ({v}).
note.rawiso.fig.region.peak: Legend of the shaded region of the peak of M; {a} and {b} = its start and end, in minutes.
note.rawiso.fig.observed: Observed ratio with its counting sigma ({r}, {s}).
note.rawiso.fig.observedOnly: Observed ratio when it has no sigma ({r}).
note.rawiso.fig.z: Distance of the observed ratio from the expected one, in sigma ({z}).
note.rawiso.fig.band: Legend of the band around the expected ratio; {k} = the z limit under which a ratio is consistent.
